doctrine: LinkedIn and Meta are distinct operating systems requiring specialized setup and ongoing rhythms. OPERATING RULES: (1) Platform infrastructure is load-bearing, not decorative. (2) Identity first on Meta (government ID verification), everything else second. (3) Centralized architecture: one Business Portfolio holding all Meta assets; one LinkedIn Company Page with linked employees. (4) Least privilege: team defaults to employee-level, not admin. (5) Setup is fragile if wrong; permanent settings (ad account timezone/currency, Business Portfolio country, business email) must be correct first attempt. LINKEDIN DOCTRINE: Treat as continuous business conference, not social media. Four buckets in order: Profile (storefront), Content (3-5 posts/week), Engagement (30-60 min daily on target accounts), Outreach (15-25 personalized connection requests/week). Minimum viable commitment: 5-10 hours/week. One-liner headline is highest-leverage element (10-12 words, names outcome not job title). Image posts with text overlay currently highest-reach format. Hooks stop scroll in first line; viral image posts have single clean visual + hook in image itself + caption expanding the image. Carousels (PDF format): 8-12 slides, hook on slide 1, promise on slide 2, content on slides 3-10, takeaway on 11, CTA on 12. Posting rhythm: 3-5 per week, Mon-Thu highest reach, 7-9 AM peak engagement, space by 20+ hours to avoid cannibalization. Engagement is mini-posts: comments on fresh posts (1-4 hrs old) within first 2 hours get higher visibility. Daily engagement block: 30-60 min, 10-20 substantive comments (15-40 words), target 30-50 accounts you want relationships with. Warm-up strategy: 20-30 min engaging before own post launch increases distribution 4x. Sales Navigator fundamentals: create persona (function + seniority + geography + company size), job-change filter (90 days) produces 3-5x higher accept/reply. Connection request opener: 3 sentences max, names specific observation + audience + problem + low-pressure value offer. Follow-up DM after acceptance: question-first, no agenda framing. Volume rules: free account 20 conn/day + 4-5 DMs/week; Sales Navigator 30+ conn/day + unlimited to connections + 50 InMails/month. Long game: 100 accepted connections yield 10-15 conversations over 6 months, 3-5 become business. META DOCTRINE: Verification non-negotiable (facebook.com/id, government ID, wait for green checkmark). Use real personal Facebook profile, not fake second account. Business Portfolio parent container with 2+ admins minimum. 2FA mandatory for all team members. Permanent settings: ad account timezone, currency, Business Portfolio country, business email. Business Suite: unified inbox (Messenger + IG DM + WhatsApp + comments in one interface), content scheduling, Lead Center free CRM. Commerce Manager: catalog feeds both Facebook Shop and Instagram Shopping (dual storefront, single inventory). Instagram Shopping requires: IG business account properly connected, shopping permissions verified, separate approval process. Lead Center pipeline: Intake (first contact) > Qualified (need + budget + authority confirmed) > In Progress (proposal/call pending) > Converted (purchased). Weekly pipeline review: 15 min, move stalled leads (3+ weeks no movement) or re-engage. Ads prerequisites: verified identity + Business Portfolio, pixel installed + conversion events configured, product catalog (if e-commerce), tested landing page, payment method. Ad account structure: one per business entity; Campaigns (objective: Sales/Leads/Traffic/Engagement/Awareness); Ad Sets (audience + placement); Ads (creative, max 6 per set for clean data). Advantage+ for most direct-response (Meta finds audience dynamically). Custom audiences outperform cold targeting. Exclusions critical: exclude existing customers from acquisition, recent purchasers from retargeting. Creative formats: short video (15-30 sec) highest engagement, UGC authentic, image + text overlay, carousels, dynamic product ads, collection ads. Ad principles: explain USP in 3 sec, educate/entertain, hook in first frame, pattern interrupt, burned-in captions (silent viewing default), specific CTA. Ban prevention: scale 30-50% per day not 10x, avoid policy-violating creative, match landing page to ad promise, complete accurate business info, avoid payment red flags. INTEGRATED CADENCE: LinkedIn 3-5 posts/week + 30-60 min daily engagement + 15-25 weekly personalized requests. Meta: ads always-on + daily message responses + weekly optimization review. Total 15-25 hours/week. Monthly: LinkedIn profile audit, ad performance review, Lead Center cleanup. Quarterly: rebalance platform allocation by ROI. SETUP TIMELINE: Week 1 (identity/foundation): Meta ID verification, LinkedIn profile draft, Business Portfolio creation, 2FA enforcement. Week 2 (LinkedIn + Meta infrastructure): complete LinkedIn profile, create ad account (verify timezone/currency), install pixel + conversion events, add payment method. Week 3 (commerce + content launch): Commerce Manager setup (if applicable), first LinkedIn post, begin daily engagement, first 10-15 connection requests. Week 4 (launch + rhythm): first Meta campaign ($20-50/day, Advantage+), Lead Center setup, establish 3-5/week posting.

gates: Do NOT run ads until: verified identity + Business Portfolio + pixel installed + conversion events configured + tested landing page + payment method active
Do NOT send 10x scaling: max 30-50% daily increase to avoid fraud detection flags
Do NOT create second Facebook profile: only use real personal profile; fakes trigger aggressive bans
Do NOT skip timezone/currency setup: permanent settings, cannot be changed post-creation
Do NOT grant admin access broadly: least-privilege default, elevate only for specific asset needs
Do NOT let agencies claim assets: only grant request-share access; claiming transfers ownership permanently
Do NOT post multiple times within 24 hours on LinkedIn: cannibalization penalty, space by 20+ hours minimum
Do NOT use engagement pods: algorithmic risk increasing; real reciprocity outperforms in long term
Do NOT use automation that mimics obvious bots: high volume in short windows triggers restrictions
Do NOT scale paid ads before organic testing: if landing page doesn't convert organic, no paid budget saves it
Do NOT send generic comments: 'great post' and emojis only; substantive comments (15-40 words, perspective/question/example) required
Do NOT exclude customers from remarketing before excluding recent purchasers: recent-buyer audience wastes ad spend

Daily LinkedIn Engagement Block: 30-60 min mornings, 10-20 comments on target accounts (1-4 hrs old), focus on 30-50 accounts, reply to own post within 1 hour, warm-up before publishing

prompts: LinkedIn one-liner template: '[Specific outcome/transformation]. I work with [target audience] on [specific problem].'
LinkedIn About opening: 'I help [target audience] [specific transformation] by [specific method].'

LinkedIn hook templates: 'Most [category] people are wrong about [topic].' / 'I [specific result] in [timeframe]. Here's how.' / 'The thing nobody tells you about [topic]:' / '[Surprising number] of [audience] don't know this.' / 'If you're [common mistake], you're losing [outcome].'
LinkedIn carousel structure: Slide 1 (hook to swipe), Slide 2 (promise), Slides 3-10 (one idea per slide), Slide 11 (takeaway), Slide 12 (CTA)

LinkedIn connection request: 'Hey [name], noticed you recently joined [company] as [role]. I work with [similar audience] on [specific problem]. Happy to share what's working for people in your seat right now if useful. Either way, wanted to connect.'

LinkedIn follow-up DM after acceptance: 'Thanks for connecting, [name]. Quick question: what's the biggest challenge on your plate in your first 90 days at [company]? No agenda here, just curious. If there's something I can point you at that's useful, happy to do that.'
Meta ad problem/solution/proof frame: Frame 1 (0-3 sec) state problem, Frame 2 (3-10 sec) introduce solution, Frame 3 (10-20 sec) show proof (testimonial/before-after/number), Frame 4 (20-30 sec) CTA
Meta ad UGC testimonial: Opening (0-3 sec customer speaks to camera, names objection), Middle (3-20 sec story), Close (20-30 sec specific outcome + situation match)
Meta ad contrarian hook: Opening (0-3 sec state common belief), Pivot (3-5 sec contrarian position), Explanation (5-20 sec why true), Close (20-30 sec product tie-in + CTA)
Sales Navigator persona elements: function (department) + seniority level + geography + company size + job-change filter (90 days)

Meta ad creative frameworks (Appendix F): problem/solution/proof, UGC testimonial, contrarian hook, demo, listicle (each with 0-30 sec timing breakdown)

LinkedIn Profile Audit Checklist (Appendix A): cover photo branded, profile photo recent, headline 10-12 words specific, About opens with problem, proof points included, CTA clear, featured 3-5 items current, recent activity 14 days, Creator Mode on, 30 hashtags selected, Services filled, contact complete, testimonials current
Meta Business Suite content scheduler: desktop + mobile preview per platform, Active Times-based scheduling, Planner calendar view
Meta Lead Center: Kanban pipeline view, custom labels, phone/email/address enrichment, follow-up reminders, stage transitions, bulk export capability
Meta Commerce Manager: catalog management, product listing optimization, shop customization (layout/collections/colors), shipping/returns configuration, Instagram Shopping linking

operating_rules: Platform infrastructure is load-bearing, not decorative. Setup determines what content can do; good content on poor setup < good content on well setup.
Identity first, everything else second. Meta ID verification is orders of magnitude cheaper than recovering a banned business account.

Centralized architecture, not scattered accounts. One Meta Business Portfolio holding all pages/IG/ad accounts/catalogs/pixels. One LinkedIn Company Page with all employees linked. Single identity across.
Least privilege on every access decision. Team defaults to employee-level. Admin only when specifically required. Every admin is additional attack surface.

Treat LinkedIn as continuous business conference (four activity buckets: walking floor/scrolling feed, speaking stage/posting, lobby conversations/commenting, business cards/connection+DM), not social media.
Profile > Content > Engagement > Outreach. Each layer makes next one work. Strong stage talk doesn't convert without lobby conversations.

Minimum viable LinkedIn practice: Profile fully optimized within week 1, revisited quarterly. Content 3-5 posts/week minimum. Engagement 30-60 min daily on target accounts. Outreach 15-25 personalized requests/week. (5-10 hours/week commitment required.)
Hook is entire post. First 2-3 lines decide everything. 'See more' click required or post invisible to algorithm.

Image posts with text overlay currently highest-reach format. Single clean visual, hook in image itself, caption expands not repeats, specific CTA at end, consistent visual style recognizable from thumbnail.
Carousels 8-12 slides optimal (shorter feels incomplete, longer loses attention). Hook slide 1, promise slide 2, content slides 3-10, takeaway slide 11, CTA slide 12.
Monday-Thursday 7-9 AM local time is peak engagement window for B2B. Space posts minimum 20 hours. Multiple posts within 24 hours cannibalize reach.

Comments are mini-posts. Appear to commenter's network, post author's notifications. Substantive comments (15-40 words, perspective/question/example) on fresh posts (1-4 hrs old) borrow reach of larger accounts.
Daily engagement block 30-60 min before own post publish. Comment 10-20 target accounts (30-50 target list of people you want relationships with). Reply to own post within 1 hour of publish.
Warm-up strategy: 20-30 min engaging before publishing own post. Creates awareness + active-account distribution boost. Same content reaches 2,000 vs 500 when account has pre-publish activity.

Inbound vs outbound: inbound slower (6-18 months) but higher quality, compounds forever. Outbound faster (weeks) but ongoing effort. Year of content+engagement produces inbound that never needs cold message again.

Sales Navigator mandatory for serious outbound. Free account limited to 20-25 conn/week. SN removes limits, adds persona + filter functionality. Persona: function + seniority + geography + company size.

Job-change filter (90 days) produces 3-5x higher accept/reply. Decision-makers info-gathering mode, establishing impact, permission to try vendors. Reach within first 30 days, frame around first 90 days of role.

Connection request openers 3 sentences max. Goal is acceptance, not close. Name specific observation + signal you read profile + name specific audience + problem + offer value first + low-pressure close.
Follow-up DM within 24 hours of acceptance. Question-first format. 'No agenda here' framing removes sales pressure. Question surfaces info for future tailoring.

Outreach volume rules: send at human rates (20 requests spread across 8 hours safer than 20 in 10 minutes). Respect TOS on automation. Accept rate > volume (40% on 20/day = 8 new/day; 20% on 50/day = 10 new but doubles risk).

Long game on LinkedIn: treat 100 accepted connections as seed pool. 10-15 become conversations at 6 months. 3-5 become business at 12 months. 3-5 justify the hundred. Engage their content, non-sales DMs (congrats, articles, relevant), be present before they have specific need.

Meta identity-first non-negotiable. Verify at facebook.com/id, government ID, green checkmark required. Only then create Business Portfolio. Time at verification is cheapest business-continuity insurance.

Use real personal Facebook profile, never fake second account. Meta explicitly prohibits fake/duplicate profiles and bans aggressively. Second profile used for Business Portfolio access, so ban takes business with it.
2FA mandatory. Compromised team member account is most common single point of failure. Set 2FA to 'Everyone' in Business Settings. Use authenticator app, not SMS (SMS interceptible).
Business Portfolio setup: verified personal profile, accurate business contact info, at least 2 additional admins minimum, each with own verified profile. Single admin is single point of failure.
Permanent Meta settings (cannot change after creation): ad account timezone, ad account currency, Business Portfolio country, business email. Get right first attempt.

Team access architecture: admin full control (max 2-3 people), employee default (access assigned assets only), finance editor (billing/payments), finance analyst (read-only financials), developer/app manager (API tokens, technical team only).
Agency/contractor access: always 'request share access' not 'claim.' Claiming transfers ownership permanently. Request sharing preserves your ownership. Revoke partnership to remove access.

Business Suite unified inbox: Messenger + IG DM + WhatsApp + Facebook comments + Instagram comments all in one place. Removes missed-message failure mode from context switching. Reply times tracked, fast responses improve Page algorithmic treatment.
Active Times data shows when your specific audience most engaged, based on historical behavior. Better than generic 'best time to post' advice. Recheck quarterly as audience grows.

Meta Lead Center free CRM sufficient for: coaches, consultants, local service businesses, small e-commerce (leads primarily from messaging). Not sufficient for: 3+ distinct lead sources, high-volume outbound, multiple channels.

Lead Center pipeline default stages: Intake (initial interest) > Qualified (need + budget + authority confirmed) > In Progress (proposal/call pending) > Converted (purchased). Stalled = 3+ weeks in stage with no movement.
Weekly pipeline review: 15 min ritual. Scan each stage, identify stalled leads, re-engage or move out, celebrate conversions. Prevents lead stalling.
Ads prerequisite gate: verified identity + Business Portfolio + pixel installed + conversion events configured + tested landing page + payment method active. Do not skip.

Ad account structure: one ad account per business entity (timezone + currency permanent). Campaigns by objective (Sales/Leads/Traffic/Engagement/Awareness). Ad Sets by audience + placement. Ads by creative (max 6 per set for clean data).

Advantage+ for most direct-response campaigns. Meta finds audience dynamically based on creative + conversion data. Outperforms manual targeting for e-commerce + lead ads with well-tracked conversion. Manual only for specific exclusions, narrow segments, or Advantage+ underperforming.

Custom audiences outperform cold targeting. Website visitors (retarget non-converters), customer list (repeat/exclude from acquisition), engagement audiences (Page/profile/Reels/ads interacted), video viewers (% watched), Lead Ad openers.

Lookalike audiences: 1% lookalike of customer list most similar/smallest/often highest-performing. 3-5% lookalike broader/larger/slightly less similar but strong. 10% lookalike broadest/for scaling exhausted narrow audiences.

Exclusion audiences critical: exclude existing customers from acquisition (don't pay to re-acquire), exclude recent purchasers from retargeting (customer yesterday doesn't need retargeting today), exclude recent leads from lead campaigns (same logic).

Ad creative formats: short video (15-30 sec) highest engagement across all placements. UGC authentic, converts well (reads as real customer review). Image + text overlay simple, works feed placements. Carousels for multiple products/message points. Dynamic product ads (auto-show viewed products to visitors). Collection ads full-screen mobile browsing.

Ad creative principles: explain USP in 3 sec (viewer knows what you sell + why it's for them), educate or entertain (ads that feel like content get watch time + engagement), hook in first frame (first frame/line/second decides everything), pattern interrupt (visual/verbal surprise), burned-in captions (silent viewing default), specific CTA ('Shop now'/'Learn more'/'Download guide' not ambiguity).
Scaling discipline non-negotiable: scale 30-50% per day, never 10x. 10x overnight triggers fraud detection. 20->30->42->63->95->142 per day is clean. 20->200 overnight triggers ban flags.

Ban prevention: scale slowly (30-50% per day), avoid policy-violating creative (sexualized content, weapons, drugs, before-after health claims, misleading financial promises), match landing page to ad promise (automated mismatch detection), complete accurate business info (incomplete/inaccurate = risk), avoid payment red flags (failed payments, card doesn't match biz name, new payment methods with no history), never link multiple accounts to same identity if previous was banned.

Commerce catalog: one catalog feeds both Facebook Shop + Instagram Shopping (dual storefront, single inventory). One product update propagates everywhere. For e-commerce 50+ products, connect e-commerce platform (Shopify/WooCommerce) for auto-sync. Manual entry for testing or small catalogs (<50).

Product listing optimization: title descriptive + keyword-rich (e.g., 'Men's Soft Cotton V-Neck T-Shirt in Navy Blue' beats 'Blue T-Shirt'), description answers common questions + pre-objects, images multi-angle high-quality lifestyle (people wearing apparel, not hanger), pricing shows promotions + strike-through original, inventory current out-of-stock damages conversion.

Shop customization worth hours: default functional but customized converts better. Choose layout (grid/masonry/featured) matching product photography. Create collections (new arrivals/bestsellers/sale/seasonal). Customize colors (primary + accent match website). Add header image/banner (first visual impression).

Shipping configuration silent failure mode: abandon rates spike when shipping unclear/expensive. Define regions (domestic/regional/international). Set rates (flat/free above threshold/weight-based; free above threshold converts well). Define return policy (30-day returns reduce purchase anxiety, clear generous policy converts better). Configure handling time accurately (overpromise/underdeliver damages reviews).

Instagram Shopping approval: link IG business account to Facebook Page. Verify in Commerce Manager Settings. Submit for approval (takes few days, Meta reviews policy compliance). Once approved, products can be tagged in posts/Stories/Reels. Followers browse tagged products + purchase without leaving IG.

Integrated funnel split: TOFU (Meta for broad reach, cheaper impressions, wider audience); MOFU (LinkedIn B2B consideration, IG consumer consideration, email nurture); BOFU (LinkedIn outreach B2B, Meta retargeting consumer, direct messaging either).

Cross-platform content adaptation: core message shared, adaptation platform-specific. Thought leadership: LinkedIn long-form hook + carousel, Meta Reel/Story visual explainer. Case study: LinkedIn narrative post + specifics, Meta before-after image/video testimonial. Product announcement: LinkedIn analytical framing + what-it-solves, Meta visual-first + product in use + shop link. Educational: LinkedIn carousel/numbered list, Meta Reel quick tips + Story series. Behind-the-scenes: LinkedIn process breakdown + thinking, Meta raw Reels + daily Stories.

Cross-platform operator cadence realistic: LinkedIn 3-5 posts/week + 30-60 min daily engagement + 15-25 weekly requests. IG 4-7 Reels/week + daily Stories + grid 2-3x/week. FB cross-post from IG via Business Suite. Ads Meta always-on + weekly review. LinkedIn ads only for specific high-value (events/leads). Total 15-25 hours/week.

Email capture on both platforms drives to same list. One source of truth for subscribers. LinkedIn content links to Meta lead magnets + vice versa. Meta retargeting audiences built from LinkedIn-sourced website visitors. LinkedIn post drives visit, Meta pixel captures, Meta retargeting closes loop.
Data handoff between platforms operational discipline, not built-in integration. Customer data from Lead Center exportable for LinkedIn outbound targeting (professional contacts only).
content_ideas: LinkedIn data posts: survey 200+ audience for shareable number, mine own operations for percentage claims, synthesize public data through operator's interpretation lens. Data gets higher share rates than opinion posts and builds authority.

LinkedIn proprietary data as format: original data shared as visual. 'Of last 50 clients, X% had Y problem.' Specific enough credible, owned enough uncopyable. Operator who publishes original data becomes primary source in category.

LinkedIn lesson-from-loss posts: 'I lost [specific] because I [mistake].' Context 2-3 lines, what happened 1 paragraph, lesson as principle, how you approach differently now. Builds credibility via vulnerability.

LinkedIn opinion posts: '[Widely-held belief] is wrong. Here's why.' State belief 1-2 lines cleanly, specific disagreement 2-3 lines, evidence (data/examples/reasoning), what operators should do instead, CTA inviting counterarguments.

LinkedIn framework posts: 'I use [N]-step framework for [outcome].' Framework name bold/caps, steps numbered, one real situation example, CTA 'Want full framework as PDF? Comment FRAMEWORK and I'll send it.'

LinkedIn contrarian hook posts: 'Most [category] people are wrong about [topic].' 2-4 line argument vs common belief, 3-5 line what's actually true, specific example from own work, 1-line takeaway, comment CTA.

LinkedIn case study posts: 'We helped [client type] go from [before] to [after] in [timeframe]. Here's how.' Client context 2 sentences, problem 2 sentences, approach 3-5 numbered steps, result with specific numbers, generalized takeaway, 'DM if facing similar challenge' CTA.
LinkedIn listicle posts: '[Number] things I wish I knew before [milestone]:' 5 items (1-2 lines each), synthesis line about what list points at, 'Which hit hardest?' comment CTA.

Meta video testimonial creative: customer speaks directly to camera, names objection they almost didn't buy because of, tells story (situation/hesitation/what changed mind/what happened after), closes with specific outcome matching viewer situation. No overlaid CTA, platform button drives click.
Meta contrarian ad creative: Opening state common belief (0-3 sec), pivot to contrarian position (3-5 sec), explain why true (5-20 sec), product tie-in + CTA (20-30 sec).
Meta demo ad creative: Opening state result you'll demonstrate (0-3 sec), demo product in use (screen recording/in-hand/before-after) with narration (3-25 sec), CTA with specific offer (25-30 sec).
Meta listicle ad creative: Opening '[N] ways to [outcome]' (0-3 sec), items quickly with visual change per item (3-25 sec), product as way to do all five (25-30 sec).

Meta problem-solution-proof ad creative: Frame 1 (0-3 sec) state problem viewer has, Frame 2 (3-10 sec) introduce solution built for them, Frame 3 (10-20 sec) proof (testimonial/before-after/number), Frame 4 (20-30 sec) CTA.

Proprietary survey-based content: survey audience on specific question (200 responses sufficient), publish surprising number + visual, unpack what data means with bullets, add operator's interpretation (proprietary layer), invite audience to add own data points.
contradictions: Half-committed LinkedIn produces half-converted outcomes vs. engagement as mini-posts can build visibility faster than own posts in first 90 days. Resolution: both true at different time horizons. Half-committed means sporadic posting (burns reach). Engagement-heavy in first 90 before own content compounds works because algorithm signals active account + you borrow reach. After 90 days, content takes over as primary driver.
weird_gold: Most Meta video watched silently. Captions burned-in are non-negotiable, not optional accessibility feature.

Active Times data dramatically better than generic 'best time to post' advice. Most B2B peaks 8-11 AM and 1-3 PM local. But some audiences (retail/lifestyle) peak evenings/weekends. Let data guide, don't override with intuition.
Engagement pods work short-term but create hollow engagement. Algorithm increasingly detects + penalizes pod behavior. Real reciprocity outperforms sustainably.
100 accepted LinkedIn connections yields only 10-15 meaningful conversations at 6 months, 3-5 business at 12 months. Ratio is floor, not ceiling. Long game required.
Second-look effect on warm-up: 20-30 min engagement before publishing own post increases distribution 4x on same content. Publication timing relative to account activity matters more than creative.
Comment placement matters: comments on 1-4 hour old posts have higher visibility because post in active algorithmic distribution. Fresh posts prioritized.
LinkedIn first 2-3 lines display completely, 'see more' required for rest. Hook is entire post. Many skip 'see more.' First 2-3 lines must carry message.
Carousels optimal at 8-12 slides. Shorter feels incomplete. Longer loses attention by slide halfway. Narrow band.
Email is only platform you own long-term. Newsletter signup should be first featured item if you have newsletter.

Lead Center optimal use: businesses whose leads come primarily from messaging (not 3+ distinct sources). Once you have multiple lead channels, proper CRM justifies cost. Lead Center free is advantage until complexity grows.
Meta Personal Facebook profile is identity foundation. Business Portfolio is child of it. Never invert or separate. Personal unverified = Business vulnerable.
Timezone permanent on ad account. Set wrong = all financial reporting off by 8-12 hours permanently. No fix. Manual adjustment forever.
UGC testimonial ad format requires no overlaid CTA. Let testimonial carry itself. Platform CTA button is only driver. Over-CTA kills authenticity advantage.
Catalog connected to e-commerce platform wins over manual for 50+ products. Auto-sync + automatic propagation to all storefronts (FB Shop + IG Shopping) eliminates manual drudgery.
Return policy generosity converts. 30-day returns reduce purchase anxiety meaningfully. Clear + generous beats restrictive.
Free shipping threshold converts better than free shipping site-wide or shipping costs visible. $75 threshold example given. Psychology of threshold bundling.
Exclusion audiences as important as inclusion. Many advertisers build inclusions but ignore exclusions, wasting spend on existing customers or recent purchasers.
1% lookalike (most similar to seed audience) often outperforms broader lookalikes despite smaller audience size. Highest-performing lookalike sometimes.
Agency asset ownership is ownership lock. If agency creates ad account under their Business Portfolio, they own it permanently. Recovery difficult/impossible. Always use request-share pattern.
Page created under personal profile (not Business Portfolio) is ownership disaster. If creator leaves, page ownership leaves with them. Create under Business Portfolio from start.
LinkedIn algorithm notices pre-publish engagement. Active account before posting gets distribution boost vs dormant account publishing same content.
Reciprocity on LinkedIn real but unstated. Show up for specific accounts' content (not pods). They notice. Over time they show up for yours. Social contract real, not forced, sustainable.
